test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

O’ Henry’s short stories are read all over the world till now because they are __pithy__.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 4' i.e. **'concise and expressive.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pithy:** This means expressing an idea cleverly and concisely (संक्षिप्त और प्रभावशाली).

 
 
• **Example: **His speech was **pithy **and to the point, leaving the audience impressed.
